mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Bio-Arcane Barrage</titleLeft><mainText>Kog'Maw has increased attack range and his attacks deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kog'Maw gains @Range@ Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalHealthDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> for @Duration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Deals a maximum of <magicDamage>@MonsterDamageCap@ magic damage</magicDamage> to Monsters.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Icathian Surprise</titleLeft><mainText>Upon dying, Kog'Maw starts a chain reaction in his body which causes him to detonate after 4 seconds, dealing @f1@ true damage to surrounding enemies.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: For @TooltipPassiveDuration@ seconds after dying, Kog'Maw can continue to move, can move through units, and gains <speed>10% Move Speed</speed>, increasing to <speed>@TooltipPassiveMS*100@% Move Speed</speed> over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes and deals <trueDamage>@PassiveDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> to nearby enemies.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Living Artillery</titleLeft><mainText>Kog'Maw's next Living Artillery will cost additional Mana.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing @BaseDamageCalc@ plus @TooltipMissingHealthDamageAmp@% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take @MaxDamageCalc@ magic damage.

Subsequent shots within @ManaCostDuration@ seconds cost an additional @BaseCost@ Mana (max: @ManaCostCap@ Mana).

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Living Artillery</titleLeft><mainText>Kog'Maw's team has vision of this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Caustic Erosion</titleLeft><mainText>This target has reduced Armor and Magic Resist.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Kog'Maw gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds @ShredAmount@% Armor and Magic Resist for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Void Ooze</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has reduced Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and leaving a trail of ooze for @TrailDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the ooze are <status>Slowed</status> by @SlowAmount@%.
